prompts.starlamp-nook:
Create one beautiful finished concept image of a TINY PRIVATE WIZARD WRITER'S ROOM for StoryOS. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024, landscape app viewport. Strong original art direction, unmistakably FANTASY CARTOON. This is a totally fresh visual direction, not a realistic room. Generate from scratch.

The viewer is inside a small cozy personal room at standing eye level, perspective suitable for a first-person 3D adventure game. A few large carefully designed objects and generous open floor/wall areas, very sparse. Five simple angled places to display books sit loosely along the edges, only three occupied by large magical story volumes. A central compact whimsical writing table is the magical book-creation place: one levitating open book, a quill and a short curling light ribbon. One comfortable odd-shaped reading chair gives a sense this is someone's home. About seven principal pieces of furniture in total, clear separation and breathing room. At least a third of the image is calm open floor or wall. A room for ONE writer, not a grand library, shop, classroom or ceremonial chamber. Shapes and furniture themselves must be clearly designed as FANTASY CARTOON PROPS, expressive, playful and simplified.

Lighting comes from a very small number of warm magical lamps and the glowing book. Rich colored shadows and readable soft ambient fill. Outside, if shown, is a simplified dark night sky; no sunlight or daytime lighting. A faint star or moon may be visible, but no beams from outside. Magic has a localized focal point and is not a dense particle cloud.

Direction name: Starlamp Nook. Dominant style: FULLY 3D CARTOON like an art-directed animated-film miniature environment, with very rounded chunky silhouettes, exaggerated proportions and playful bendy furniture. Big soft bevels and simple matte color surfaces, minimal surface texture, clearly non-photoreal. Gently curving midnight-blue walls, wide floor planks drawn with just one stroke each, a few thick sweeping purple-brown ceiling beams, warm caramel edging. Five short friendly crooked wooden book cradles, thick emerald and plum leather book covers with single tiny star clasp. The central writing table has three curvy legs and a crescent-shaped top; glowing paper above it is the warm golden focal point. One tall-backed soft moss-green reading chair curled like a leaf. Two SMALL hovering warm star-shaped lanterns, a little round window showing a flat dark starry sky. Deep indigo and muted teal with warm apricot-gold light, dark but welcoming and easy to read. Cozy fantasy, cute in shape yet refined and spacious; avoid plastic shine. Strong appealing cartoon prop silhouettes must be visible immediately.
